name: images_expand
description: AI outpaint to `aspectRatio`: keeps the original and generates new surroundings, anchoring the subject automatically. Crop instead (no new pixels): `images_crop`. Ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9.

prompt.description: Optional hint for what to generate in the new area, e.g. "sandy beach".

folderReference.description: Optional project/folder reference from `folders_list` to place results in. Omit for the default.
